title: Margaritaville - Nashville - Studio
description:
Skyline Rooftop Pool + Broadway Nights – Nashville, TN

Start your day with coffee and skyline views, stroll downtown Nashville’s iconic music spots, relax poolside, then unwind with a frozen drink in your island-inspired studio.

The space
Studio

Occupancy: Up to 4 guests
Room Size: 400–645 sq. ft.
Beds: 1 King bed, 1 Queen sleeper sofa

Amenities:
Partial kitchen with microwave, sink, mini-fridge
Sitting area with TV
Coffee maker, in-room safe, hairdryer
Modern island-style decor
Complimentary WiFi

Other things to note
Please bring a valid Picture ID. If the name of the person checking in is changed after this information is provided, there will be a $99.00 name change fee and $129 on the day of check in. A $250 Pre-Authorization from any major credit card upon checking in is required. Cash is not accepted.
